  "additional_concerns": [
    "All selected claims are supported by the retained source, including the non-exhaustive designation factors in u21 and the LAF exclusion in footnote 6; none is implemented by these classification-only formulas.",

    "The candidates' assessment-time and conflict-handling conventions are implementation choices rather than rules expressly prescribed by the retained source.",
    "A FALSE classification result under these formulas does not establish exemption from sale requirements under other applicable authorities."
  ],
